purpose: Resolve equipment display metadata without reopening Stage 2 semantics. Icon comes directly from the confirmed EquipmentInfo master; Korean names come only from the existing Korean equipment sheet and are accepted only when the source row can be safely matched to a canonical equipment ID.

icon.policy: Direct confirmed basic metadata relation; do not derive icon from ItemInfo or Korean-sheet image filenames.

nameKr.policy: Never invent or machine-translate a missing Korean name. Preserve source sheet/row provenance and leave nameKr null with REVIEW_NAME_KR when the row is absent or the ID match is not strong enough.
nameKr.legacyParentheticalPolicy: In 추가장비 rows, when the cell contains a former/collaboration name followed by a parenthetical generic/current Korean name, use the last parenthetical label as nameKr and preserve the original source cell in provenance.

matchingPolicy.launch: Match only inside the frozen launch population and source slot/subtype. Exact stat/effect signatures are preferred; ambiguous equal-score rows remain REVIEW rather than being guessed.
matchingPolicy.legacyAdditional: Reuse the frozen legacy-additional class/date structure. Matching stays inside the same release group whenever releaseGroupDate exists.
matchingPolicy.exclusiveEquipment: Use the frozen exclusive-equipment population and monotonic source/canonical order only as a disambiguation constraint after slot/stat/effect evidence. A low-score forced sequence match is never accepted as a Korean name.
doNotUse: name translation similarity as an automatic join
raw Label order as display order

requirements: Every general/exclusive page-ready equipment record has a non-empty direct EquipmentInfo icon.
Every page-ready record has an explicit nameKrStatus.
Every non-null nameKr has source sheet/row provenance and an accepted match score.
Missing or ambiguous Korean names remain explicit REVIEW; no synthetic translation is inserted.
Stage 2 classification, stats, effects, restrictions and acquisition semantics are not recomputed.
